paragraphs.text: The Kodama of the South Tree is a kami of the Summer Tree of the Jukai on Kamigawa .

The Kodama of the South Tree is the kami of the Summer Tree in the Jukai forest, one of the Five Trees . It values community above all else, though a community with certain rules. It cares about all living things in its forest and wants everything in its proper place. While normally friendly, it became fierce and full of hate during the Kami War .
